concerns.text: The plan streams the PubChem dataset and then selects the *first* 5 000 valid molecules ("deterministic random seed (42) selects the first 5 000 valid molecules"). Selecting the first N records after streaming can introduce systematic bias if the source ordering is not random. This threatens construct validity of the sampled data and may confound the comparison between traditional and topological descriptors. Replace the deterministic “first‑N” approach with a truly random sample (e.g., shuffle the streamed records with the fixed seed before sub‑sampling) or explicitly verify that the dataset is already randomly ordered.
